tool_input.command:
cd . 2>/dev/null; F=features/supervision.feature
O1="a work-item drafted for a formulated capability-proposal lists under its Retires each deprecated scenario of a requirement it accepts"
O2="a work-item drafted for a formulated capability-proposal whose changes name a range lists under its Retires each deprecated scenario of a requirement in the range"
S=/home/vscode/shopsystem-bdd/scripts
python3 $S/features deprecate "$O1" --for "a work-item lists under its Retires each deprecated scenario whose Deprecated for line names a scenario of a requirement it accepts" --file $F && python3 $S/features rebind --file $F "$O1" "$O1 (deprecated)" && python3 $S/features deprecate "$O2" --for "a work-item that accepts a range lists under its Retires each deprecated scenario whose Deprecated for line names a scenario of a requirement in the range" --file $F && python3 $S/features rebind --file $F "$O2" "$O2 (deprecated)"; git status --porcelain

python3 - <<'E'
d=open('.shop/scratch/3-formulate/drafts/round-1/supervision.feature').read().splitlines()
new="\n".join(l[2:] if l.startswith("  #")==False else None for l in d if not l.lstrip().startswith("#"))
# keep original indentation: drafts already indented 2
new="\n".join(l for l in d if not l.lstrip().startswith("#")).strip("\n")+"\n\n"
p='features/supervision.feature'
s=open(p).read()
m="  @r74\n  Scenario: a kept branch"
assert s.count(m)==1
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(m,new+m))
E
python3 /home/vscode/shopsystem-bdd/scripts/features bindings | tail -2; python3 /home/vscode/shopsystem-bdd/scripts/model check --limit 100000 2>&1 | tail -30
